description: Oil-painting style scene. A tall black stone stele dominates the centre, with a relief carving at the top showing a standing figure facing a seated bearded figure in a horned crown holding a rod. Below, columns of carved wedge-like script cover the stone. Around it, bearded men in robes and head cloths look up, one holds a torch-like flame at left, and a man at right swings a hammer on a chisel against the stone. Dark, smoky interior with stone walls, painted edge to edge.
